body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2013') - Pison Contents (www.musicspray.net) unveiled its online sound distributor for iTunes, 'Music Spray', at the world's largest electronics exhibition 'CES 2013'.

'Music Spray' is One-stop web/mobile integrated distribution platform for Digital music. The official distributor 'Pison Contents' manages and develops the world's largest digital music markets, iTunes and Amazon Mp3. You can sell your songs worldwide by using 'Music Play' with lower price and simple progress.

The manual for ' Music Spray' is simple. Once you upload musics with small charge of membership fee after making artist account, you can sell your musics to online music sites such as Melon and Bugs at the same time.
In addition, Music spray charges no additional fees at all after your registration and do not demand annual fees or unnecessary commission like other foreign online distributors do.

'MUSIC SPRAY' used to have distribution request from Indi musicians before, But nowadays music distribution requests for famous artist so called 'Korean wave star' Ryu, si-won and 015B, Myname, Jjun and Alli , are increasing without any special promotion.

President Ryu at Pison contents said " We participated in CES 2013 exhibition to survey the market between digital music and IT appliances. Especially, Pison contents found direction with pandora service embedded in Ford. We secured about 10,000 of Indi musics and K POP that we will constantly increase the quantity to have business with an automobile companies near future.
